description: This file defines a PHP class ProspectsViewEdit that extends ViewEdit, configuring certain properties related to the Prospects module in SuiteCRM, specifically for editing view functionality. It also includes licensing information and access control checks.

classes.name: ProspectsViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to customize the editing interface for Prospects in SuiteCRM, enabling use in subpanels and quick create templates.
